s.en: a script to setup restricted rsync users via ssh logins

syn: rrsync [-ro|-wo] [-munge] [-absolute] [-no-del] [-no-lock] [-no-overwrite] DIR ⏎ The single non-option argument specifies the restricted DIR to use. It can be relative to the user's home directory or an absolute path. ⏎ The online version of this manpage (that includes cross-linking of topics) is available at https://download.samba.org/pub/rsync/rrsync.1.

o.en: Allow only reading from the DIR. Implies -no-del and -no-lock.
Allow only writing to the DIR.

Allow file-transfer arguments to name the restricted directory using its absolute server path. For example, with rrsync -absolute /path/to/root, the transfer arg /path/to/root/dir1 is accepted as an alias for dir1.
Avoid the single-run (per-user) lock check. Useful with -munge.

Enforce --ignore-existing on the server. Prevents overwriting existing files when the server is the receiver. Because --ignore-existing protects only the file being transferred, this also refuses the options that can reach a different existing file in the restricted dir: --log-file, --partial-dir, --delay-updates, and backup…
Output this help message and exit.
